names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 iunie, «Sfântul Cuvios Ilarion cel Nou, egumenul Mănăstirii Dalmaților».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Ιλαρίων ο νέος, ηγούμενος Μονής Δαλμάτων», with the rank word left off. The epithet and the office in the day's line are left off the stored form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 6. јун ст. ст., „Преподобни Иларион Нови“ — Преподобни is the `venerable` this corpus puts in `types` and is stripped; Нови is the epithet the man took with the name and is not a rank, so it stays, and the form is the fullest the heading gives. **IT IS NOT UNIQUE AND THAT IS KNOWN**: `foldchk.py` returns `[('hilarion-the-new-of-pelecete', 'sr')]`, the identical string on another Hilarion the New kept by this same book on another day. The house is in neither heading, so neither form can be made fuller, and the two are told apart by their days.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 930 gives it, «Иларион Новый, Далматский, игумен, исповедник», with the two grades, both of which this folder already carries in `types` taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'далматскии иларион новыи' has no other holder. Both name words are kept and the calendar's own comma with them, as for «Дада Доростольский, Озовийский»: Новый is what tells him from the other Hilarions and Далматский is the house, and the folder's Romanian form «Ilarion cel Nou» and Serbian «Иларион Нови» already carry the first of the two.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Илариона Нового, из обители Далматской (845).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry of eight, «Прп. Илариона Нового, из обители Далматской (845).». The Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows all stand on this same 6 June, and the line gives the New, the monastery of Dalmatou and the year 845 this folder already holds. The day page prints ONE troparion for him and Bessarion together and a kontakion of his own, and both are added; the kontakion calls him «новый Иларионе» and speaks of the many torments and sorrows he took for piety, which is the confessor's part this folder already carries in `types`. `life1246` was NOT read, so nothing of his life is touched here. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 iunie — «Sfântul Cuvios Ilarion cel Nou, egumenul Mănăstirii Dalmaților»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Ιλαρίων ο νέος, ηγούμενος Μονής Δαλμάτων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and dates him «(775 - 845)». It is plainly the same man: abbot of the monastery of the Dalmatians, a confessor under the iconoclast Leo the Armenian. saint.gr prints two apolytikia and a kontakion; the first apolytikion is taken. The kontakion, Ἦχος α', Τὸν τάφον σου Σωτήρ, addresses a martyr who was not burnt in the fire and calls him «Ἰλάριε», a different form of the name; it is left where it is and not copied, because the folder's man was not tried by fire.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.06.2026 (6. јун ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Иларион Нови“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. A THIRD BOOK THAT ADDS NOTHING AND AGREES EXACTLY, WHICH IS WORTH SAYING. Every sentence of this entry is already on the folder off doxologia: abbot of the Dalmatou house in Constantinople; disciple of Gregory the Decapolite; imitator of Hilarion the Great, whose name he took; mighty in prayer and brave in suffering; much suffered for the icons under Leo the Armenian; **Leo cut down with swords by his own soldiers in the very church and the very place where he had first mocked the holy icons and from which he took the first icon down**; Hilarion let out of prison and shortly tortured and imprisoned again until the Orthodox empress Theodora; **the angels of God seen carrying the soul of Theodore the Studite to heaven**. The two most striking sentences in the entry are the two the Romanian life already has almost word for word. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE AGREEMENT IS EXACT TO THE AGE. saint.gr gives «(775 - 845)» and «εκοιμήθη ειρηνικά σε ηλικία 70 ετών, το 845»; this book gives „упокојио се у царству небеском 845. године у својој седамдесетој години“ — the same year and the same seventieth year. **Nothing to widen; the seventieth year is not used to derive the 775 either, which saint.gr prints for itself.** `types` and `office` untouched, all four corroborated or unaffected: Преподобни is the `venerable`, Игуман the `abbot` and the `Abbot` in `office`, and the suffering for the icons under an iconoclast emperor is the `confessor`. `related` untouched: Gregory the Decapolite, Hilarion the Great and Theodore the Studite are all three already there, which is every person this entry names but the emperors. An emperor in a life is not a relation. No `locations`. **THE FOLD IS THE FINDING OF THE ENTRY, AND IT IS ON THE FULL FORM AND NOT A BARE ONE.** `foldchk.py` returns `[('hilarion-the-new-of-pelecete', 'sr')]` for «Иларион Нови»: **the identical two-word string, epithet and all, is already stored for a different Hilarion the New**, of the Pelecete monastery, off this same book’s own other day. The form is stored a second time on purpose — it is what this heading prints and there is no third word in it — and the two are told apart by their houses and their days. **They are certainly two men**: this entry says „Игуман Далматске обитељи у Цариграду“ and names Gregory the Decapolite as his teacher. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Ilarion, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Ilarion cel Nou, egumenul Mănăstirii Dalmaților, Glasul 8

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighs out of the deep thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou wast made a light to the world, shining with wonders, Hilarion our father. Pray Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Τῶν λόγων τοῦ Κυρίου τὴν χάριν γεωργήσας, ἤνθησας καθάπερ ἔλαια, παμμάκαρ Ἰλαρίων, ἐλαίω τῶν θείων ἀρετῶν, καὶ τῆς ὁμολογίας σου σοφέ, ἰλαρύνων τᾶς καρδίας καὶ τᾶς ψυχᾶς, τῶν πίστει σοὶ ἐκβοώντων δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοὶ ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντη, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διά σου, πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Τοῦ λίθου σφραγισθέντος, the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Όσιος Ιλαρίων ο νέος, ηγούμενος Μονής Δαλμάτων»

english.text: Having tilled the grace of the words of the Lord, you blossomed like an olive tree, all-blessed Hilarion, with the oil of the divine virtues and of your confession, O wise one, gladdening the hearts and the souls of those who cry out to you in faith: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all men through you.

hymns.text: Боже отец наших,/ творяй присно с нами по Твоей кротости,/ не отстави милость Твою от нас,/ но молитвами их// в мире управи живот наш.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь преподобных Виссариона и Илариона», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 6 июня ст. ст.. It is printed ONCE, for the two of them together, and is the common of venerable fathers in the plural — it names neither man and says only «но молитвами их», by their prayers. Its heading sets it over both, so it is on both folders (BRIEF.md §4).

english.text: O God of our fathers, who dealest ever with us according to Thy gentleness, take not Thy mercy from us, but by their prayers govern our life in peace.

hymns.text: Ограды живоносныя твоея пажити,/ пастырски невредимо стадо соблюл еси/ и явился еси высотою дел велик, новый Иларионе,/ по благочестии многи муки и скорби прием:/ тем во всерадостный живот вселився Горняго Сиона,// моли за ны, преподобне.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак преподобного Илариона», глас 2, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 6 июня ст. ст.. It names him in the vocative as «новый Иларионе», the New, which is the epithet the day line gives him too.

english.text: Thou didst keep the flock of thy life-giving pasture unharmed as a shepherd keeps it, and wast shown great by the height of thy deeds, O new Hilarion, having taken many torments and sorrows for the sake of piety; wherefore, having come to dwell in the all-joyful life of the Sion on high, pray thou for us, O venerable one.

birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Οσιος Ιλαριων ο Νεος, Ηγουμενος Μονης Δαλματων (775 - 845)», and the body repeats it: «Ο Όσιος Ιλαρίων γεννήθηκε το 775 μ.Χ. και καταγόταν από την Καππαδοκία.»

death.note: saint.gr: «επέστρεψε στη Μονή του, έζησε τρία ακόμη χρόνια και εκοιμήθη ειρηνικά σε ηλικία 70 ετών, το 845 μ.Χ.»
